eir.0950 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0950.t
	desc = eir.0950.desc
	theme = legend

	trigger = {
		has_global_variable = eir_done_mystic_celts
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0950.a
		stress_impact = {
			cynical = minor_stress_impact_loss
			zealous = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_prestige = major_prestige_gain
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_foreknowledge_modifier years = 8 }
		add_piety = minor_piety_loss
		eir_trait_effect = { TRAIT = cynical OPPOSITE = zealous CHANCE = 25 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				has_trait = cynical
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0950.b
		trigger = {
			piety >= 100
		}
		stress_impact = {
			zealous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			cynical = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_piety = major_piety_gain
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_peace_with_church_modifier years = 8 }
		remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
		ai_chance = {
			base = 35
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				has_trait = zealous
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0950.c
		stress_impact = {
			brave = minor_stress_impact_loss
			craven = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = medium_gold_value
		add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
		eir_defender_levy_effect = yes
		add_dread = minor_dread_gain
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = brave
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0950.d
		stress_impact = {
			shrewd = minor_stress_impact_loss
			trusting = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		add_stress = minor_stress_loss

			base = 20
